_comment: Per-set × per-case budgets over pano_metrics.py outputs (test_pano_pipeline.sh). One-way ratchet under engineering control: ceilings only go DOWN and the coverage FLOOR only goes UP, in the same commit that delivers the improvement. Semantics or direction changes are OWNER decisions and carry a dated note. 2026-06-12 (owner): pano_01 re-encoded after #1225 (place-every-frame retention + stage-F mesh + fixed-point pruning) — greens ratcheted to the measured all-21 result: ceilings (mean 1.13, rmse 0.2026, seam 8.88e-4) with ~6% slack, and the coverage FLOOR 0.928→0.92 with a deliberately tighter ~0.9% slack (coverage moves only when frames or canvas extent are lost — it needs no noise margin); max_reproj raised 6.0→6.05 (the measured 6.006 is one evidence-floor pair of an open-water frame — pruning it would un-pose the frame; ratchet back when alignment earns it); horizon_tilt raised 0.3→0.4 (the metric gates the WORST single camera's x-axis, and one motion-degraded pose owns it even when the rendered horizon is level — revisit if the metric is re-encoded as a rendered-horizon measure). More fixture sets are planned; new sets follow the run-once → observed+5-10% flow.

stitch._comment: Well-shot 21-frame DJI gimbal sweep with reference. The acceptance set. Re-encoded 2026-06-12 post-#1225 at the measured all-21 default-flags result; see the top-level note for the max/tilt owner decisions.

3-frame nadir strip (frame 0001 missing from capture) — tile strategy (auto selects tile for this translation-dominant set, spec §8 #1226). No reference (no coverage/rmse keys). No horizon gate (nadir). No rotation-model reproj keys (the tile path does not run rotation BA). dropped_frames=0 is the product bar for well-shot sets.

23-frame 100MP nadir grid pass (DJI L3D-100c, single strip over Paris, ~90% forward overlap). Tile strategy (auto: 40 tile votes / 0 rotation). No reference (no coverage/rmse keys), no horizon gate (nadir), no rotation reproj keys. 2026-08-31 (#3086): first entry at the measured post-fix result — 0 orphans, mean planar 6.70px, max 12.89px, canvas capped 977MP→256MP; dropped_frames=0 is the product bar for well-shot strips.

9-frame 100MP nadir grid pass (DJI L3D-100c, single strip over Dune du Pilat; frame 0306 missing from capture — the 0305→0307 gap still verifies). Tile strategy (auto: 25 tile votes / 1 rotation). No reference, no horizon gate, no rotation reproj keys. 2026-08-31 (#3086): first entry at the measured post-fix result — 0 orphans, mean planar 10.94px, max 23.42px.

Synthetic 6-frame 180° partial ring (pano-gen-fixture, seed 42, 1280×960 px, 60° FOV, 50% overlap). Rotation-BA strategy (mean 0.070px, max 0.216px). No reference (gitignored) — gates on StitchReport metrics only. Ceilings at observed + ~10-15% slack. Peak RSS measured on main post-#1252 (/usr/bin/time -l, this 6-frame set): full canvas 9.66 GB (9.00 GiB); --canvas-tile-rows 512: 7.65 GB (7.13 GiB) — 20.8% reduction. Both paths produce identical BA geometry (tiling bounds composite residency only, not the match/refine peak — see #1254).
